parts.instruction: You will hear someone giving a talk. Label the places (19-22) on the map (A-H). There are THREE extra options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.

q19.text: Jo Tremaine sculptures are displayed on this side of the upper lake, just behind the education centre and near the bridge — location E.

q20.text: Giorgio Catalucci Bird sculptures are just across the bridge on the north side of the lower lake — location C.

q21.text: Garden gallery is on this side of the upper lake. From the visitor centre, go to the education centre, then keep on along the path, and you'll see it on your right — location F.

q22.text: Long house: from the bridge turn left, follow the winding pathway going up towards the northern boundary — location A.
